reasons.persona_fit: Directly speaks to small-business owners in Bareni's calm, practical voice. Respects human-in-the-loop rules for collections and payment, and includes no prohibited CTA.
reasons.clarity: Logical, clean structure that defines a single bounded workflow, presents a simple evaluation test, and avoids jargon.
reasons.actionability: Provides an immediate, low-overhead diagnostic step (auditing one week of invoices) tailored to small-business operations.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly adheres to boundaries; makes no claims of invented customers, fake metrics, or unverified automated capabilities.
